anatomy.web: audio-player.tsx wraps media-chrome/react: AudioPlayer (MediaController with audio set and a style object of --media-* variables pointing at system tokens), AudioPlayerElement (an audio element in slot media with a src or an AI SDK data object), AudioPlayerControlBar (MediaControlBar around a horizontal ButtonGroup), and the controls: play, seek backward and forward (outline icon-sm Buttons as child), time and duration displays, mute (ButtonGroupText), and the time and volume ranges.
